status_meaning.working: unlocked on Windows with the generic nv-uefi-unlocker loader, matched results reported
status_meaning.port-only: unlocked on Windows only with a per-board port; the generic loader has no report yet
status_meaning.untested: no Windows report yet; the chip family is routed, so a careful replay-first test is reasonable
status_meaning.partial: the transaction completes but the speed-up is lost or missing on some boards
status_meaning.not-needed: already runs at full rate, nothing to unlock

2684.name: RTX 4090
2684.notes: Generic loader v2.1.6: transaction and selector read-back clean, but only 1.45x at FP16 4096 and 1.11x at 8192 (power wall plus a suspected second gate; under investigation). A per-board port on an MSI Z790 GODLIKE gave similar partial gains.

2685.name: RTX 4090 D
2685.notes: Linux runs show TF32 GEMM gains; BF16 large GEMMs can stay flat.

2702.name: RTX 4080 SUPER
2702.notes: TOTORONG-lineage UEFI ports worked on two boards.

2704.name: RTX 4080
2704.notes: Generic loader v2.1.0, retail card, Windows 11: FP16 4096 1.85x, 8192 1.57x (power-bound), FP32 control flat. The TOTORONG per-board port also worked.

2705.name: RTX 4070 Ti SUPER
2705.notes: Generic loader v2.1.0 on an AMD desktop: FP16 GEMM 62.0 to 125.3 TFLOPS (2.02x). On an X570 it hung at the GOP reconnect and showed Code 12 with the reconnect skipped; v2.1.6 adds the reconnect-safe switch for the hang, Code 12 is still open. Per-board ports also worked.

2709.name: RTX 4070 (newer SKU)
2709.notes: Generic loader on a desktop RTX 4070 (AD103, 46 SMs): FP16, BF16 and FP8 GEMM about 2.0x.

2782.name: RTX 4070 Ti
2782.notes: Latence.app MSI reference port and a Gigabyte port worked.

2783.name: RTX 4070 SUPER
2783.notes: Generic loader v0.1.4 on a Palit card, MSI B760: FP16 GEMM 70.5 to 100.1 TFLOPS.

2803.name: RTX 4060 Ti (8 GB or 16 GB)
2803.notes: Generic loader on an H310, an MSI B550M (also dual-GPU), an AMD desktop (16 GB, +64%) and an ASUS Z790 APEX (8 GB): FP16 +70%, BF16 +75%.

2805.name: RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB
2805.notes: Generic loader v2.1.0 on an Intel NUC13: FP16 45.8 to 75.2 TFLOPS.

28a0.name: RTX 4060 Laptop
28a0.notes: Generic loader v2.1.4 on a MECHREVO laptop in dGPU-direct mode: FP16 GEMM 26.4 to 50.3 TFLOPS (1.91x). On Linux, disable runtime power-down.

28e0.name: RTX 4060 Laptop
28e0.notes: Generic loader on an ASUS TUF A15 (v0.2.0) and an Acer Predator PHN16-71 (v2.1.0, FP16 GEMM up to about 2x), both with the dGPU driving the display.

2757.name: RTX 4090 Laptop
2757.notes: Linux: 2.00x on Lenovo and Alienware, no change on a Clevo.

2717.name: RTX 4090 Laptop
2717.notes: Same die as 2757; not yet admitted.

2860.name: RTX 4070 Laptop
2860.notes: Unlocks at handoff, back to half rate after the NVIDIA driver starts.

2206.name: RTX 3080
2206.notes: Generic loader v2.1.0 on an MSI Z490: FP16 GEMM about 2x, power-capped.

2420.name: RTX 3080 Ti Laptop
2420.notes: Generic loader v2.1.0, dGPU-only mode. One run left the BIOS display broken until an EC reset. A modded desktop 3080 Ti on the same die (X99) hung at the GOP reconnect until v2.1.6, then fully unlocked with tx-reconnect-nonrecursive.

2484.name: RTX 3070
2484.notes: Generic loader: the firmware-side unlock completes, but Windows shows Code 12 on the reported desktop boards (under investigation). A Thunderbolt eGPU unlocked and survived FLR, then was back at half rate in Windows.

249d.name: RTX 3070 Laptop
249d.notes: Worked in MUX dGPU-only mode; a hybrid-only laptop got no gain. An adapted Windows-GPU-UNLOCK port unlocked a MUXless Optimus model (FP16 about 2x at a pinned clock) by enabling memory decode and checking no display runs on the dGPU. There the unlock is lost when Windows powers the idle dGPU down (RTD3); a CUDA keep-alive started at logon holds it.

2520.name: RTX 3060 Laptop
2520.notes: Generic loader v2.1.6 on a VRAM-modded 3060 Mobile (12 GB) in an X99 desktop: FP16 +83%, BF16 +86%.

2b85.name: RTX 5090
2b85.notes: Rate set by fuses; host writes dropped.

2c18.name: RTX 5090 Laptop
2c18.notes: Rate set by fuses; host writes dropped.

2216.name: RTX 3080 LHR
2216.notes: Generic loader on a B550 board, no iGPU: FP16 GEMM +63 to +68%, SDXL +29%.

2504.name: RTX 3060 12 GB
2504.notes: Generic loader v2.1.6 on an ASUS X470-F: FP16 GEMM 1.80x. The recursive reconnect reset the board; no-reconnect.txt worked around it.
